title: Cross-lingual transfer of a deception/honesty steering vector on a multilingual open model

original_idea.body: Extract a RepE honesty reading vector on an English contrast set in a multilingual open model, then apply it unchanged while prompting in Spanish/French/Swahili/Hindi to measure whether honesty behavior shifts per language.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: cross-lingual steering decay leaves multilingual users under-protected, but link has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: RepE honesty vector + multilingual evals; open-source tooling.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Multilingual safety neglected by English-tuned labs, open models.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-lingual transfer reported; safety-concept replication may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Honesty-specific multilingual replication may be partly open.
